title: Leo Borromeo bags double gold at Makati Speedcubing Open IX

blocks.text: Two-time Philippine Championship 4x4 champion and 2025 National 3x3 champion Leo Borromeo emerged victorious after claiming both titles at the Makati Speedcubing Open IX 2026 on Oct. 11 at SM Makati, after posting a 6.05-second average in the 3x3 event.
